spec.name: readme
spec.note:
A small-sample pilot: 3 games per (deck, model, opponent) for Haiku and Sonnet and 1 for Opus, so the 95%
intervals are wide and the ordering between the Claude models isn't settled. Opus played only game 1 of each pairing,
where the AI seat goes first; the like-for-like table compares every backend on those same games. The baselines play
30 games per pairing. The run is resumable: raise the counts in bench/configs/readme.toml and
`ygo-agent bench readme --resume` plays only the new games, on the same seeds.
